sources.note: The five unmodified targets pass. On 15 November 2026, the Isabelle proof was re-run in Docker using explicit state cases, and the CSP suite was re-run in FDR after an untimed power-loss protocol refinement was added. The final suite detects all 16 selected faults; all six controls pass. Full new results and logs are in results/isabelle_cases/, results/fdr_powerloss/ and results/verification_baseline/. Each new checker was also re-run for both change scenarios. Dafny and Java mutant/control results and the non-Isabelle/non-FDR scenario results are retained from the earlier bound-thread run because those artefacts are unchanged. The earlier killed I4 attempt and the earlier surviving F3 result are retained under sources.proofUpdate.previousI4 and sources.cspResponseUpdate.previousF3. These additions address gaps found in the initial run; the final detection total is not an independent estimate of fault-detection performance.
